Add an opt-in versioned witness for every managed run/reset and actual pending-read boundary while preserving default preflight v1 and historical replay. Reject unsafe pending state before reset can erase it, retain original exceptions, and bind terminal state to actual destruction.

Add strict readers, bounded orchestration, native accessor and always-zero probes, and a dedicated hosted workflow. Retain compiled parent sensitivity, 90 integrated host tests, 30 probe tests, historical compatibility, and independent review evidence. Native execution and full governance remain pending this checkpoint; all qualification and warm acceptance claims stay false.
